answer: Fund shared projects with quadratic matching plus a pairwise-coordination discount: the bonus grows with the number of distinct agents backing a project, but each pair of backers who co-back many of the same projects counts for less. A Sybil operator who splits one wallet into 200 fakes that whisper identical votes builds a hollow crowd whose overlap gives it away, so the match shrinks toward what one backer would get. To escape, each fake needs its own atlas of independent choices and real capital, so the attack costs full price per identity.
